initial.instructions: Apply an LDIF Modify to the backend serving dc=deployment,dc=test, replacing only its olcAccess values. Within its People branch, let established people update only their own mail and description; let uid=desk,ou=Service,dc=deployment,dc=test update description there but never mail. Deny other writes, including Archive and Service; a denied multi-field request must change nothing. Preserve every other configuration entry and every unrelated directory value across all samples.
initial.starter:
version: 1

dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcAccess
olcAccess: to * by users write by * none
-
initial.reference:
version: 1

dn: olcDatabase={2}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
replace: olcAccess
olcAccess: to dn.subtree="ou=People,dc=deployment,dc=test" attrs=description by dn.exact="uid=desk,ou=Service,dc=deployment,dc=test" write by self write by * none
olcAccess: to dn.subtree="ou=People,dc=deployment,dc=test" attrs=mail by self write by * none
olcAccess: to * by * none
-

probes.label: Same uid in another branch is not self
Same uid in another branch is not self

cases.label: Nested People and a third caller

probes.label: Same uid in another branch is not self

databases.name: olcDatabase={2}mdb,cn=config
access: to * by users write by * none
